instruction: Fix `hex_encode` in `codec/binary.py` so it returns the hex string (a str), not the raw bytes. It currently returns the UTF-8 bytes directly instead of calling `.hex()` on them.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/binary.py b/codec/binary.py
--- a/codec/binary.py
+++ b/codec/binary.py
@@ -17,7 +17,7 @@
 
 def hex_encode(data: str) -> str:
     """Hex-encode ``data``'s UTF-8 bytes."""
-    return to_bytes(data)
+    return to_bytes(data).hex()
 
 
 def hex_decode(text: str) -> str:
